summary: A mixed legal and business day dominated by regulatory developments affecting retail operations and market infrastructure. Supreme Court's PMLA ruling and new e-commerce safeguards create compliance obligations, while Reliance's $1.3 billion rupee bond sale signals major capital activity in debt markets.

bullets.text: Supreme Court reserves verdict on whether PMLA adjudicating authority can function without a judicial member.
India tightens e-commerce rules with new consumer safeguards affecting retail operations and seller compliance.
Reliance Industries to raise $1.3 billion via rupee bond sale, first issuance since 2023.
Nifty plunged 462 points in under 30 seconds during Tuesday closing auction session before recovery.
Indian consumer regulator escalates probe into Apple's software warranty terms.
